mapper.select: SELECT m.personal_or_corporate, m.last_name, m.first_name, m.last_name_kana, m.first_name_kana, m.company_name, m.department_name, m.email, m.daytime_phone, m.fax, m.postal_code, m.prefecture, m.city, m.address_line, m.delivery_floor, m.has_elevator FROM members m WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId} AND m.member_status = 'active'

INSERT INTO orders ( order_number, order_datetime, order_status, customer_type, personal_or_corporate, member_id, customer_last_name, customer_first_name, customer_last_name_kana, customer_first_name_kana, company_name, department_name, customer_email, daytime_phone, shipping_fax, shipping_postal_code, shipping_prefecture, shipping_city, shipping_address_line, shipping_floor, shipping_has_elevator, payment_method, payment_instruction, shipping_method, shipping_fee, assembly_fee_total, subtotal_amount, tax_amount, total_amount, receipt_issued, note, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.orderNumber}, #{params.orderDatetime}, 'received', #{params.customerType}, #{params.personalOrCorporate}, #{params.memberId}, #{params.customerLastName}, #{params.customerFirstName}, #{params.customerLastNameKana}, #{params.customerFirstNameKana}, #{params.companyName}, #{params.departmentName}, #{params.customerEmail}, #{params.daytimePhone}, #{params.shippingFax}, #{params.shippingPostalCode}, #{params.shippingPrefecture}, #{params.shippingCity}, #{params.shippingAddressLine}, #{params.shippingFloor}, #{params.shippingHasElevator}, #{params.paymentMethod},
CAST(#{params.paymentInstructionJson} AS jsonb)
NULL
, #{params.shippingMethod}, #{params.shippingFee}, #{params.assemblyFeeTotal}, #{params.subtotalAmount}, #{params.taxAmount}, #{params.totalAmount}, FALSE, NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) RETURNING order_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_items ( order_id, product_code, product_name, color_name, unit_price, quantity, line_subtotal, line_tax_amount, line_total_amount, assembly_available, assembly_fee, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.orderId}, #{params.productCode}, #{params.productName}, #{params.colorName}, #{params.unitPrice}, #{params.quantity}, #{params.lineSubtotal}, #{params.lineTaxAmount}, #{params.lineTotalAmount}, #{params.assemblyAvailable}, #{params.assemblyFee}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
INSERT INTO order_status_histories ( order_id, status, changed_by_system, changed_at ) VALUES ( #{params.orderId}, #{params.status}, #{params.changedBySystem}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: INSERT INTO order_number_counters ( order_date, last_sequence, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{orderDate}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (order_date) DO UPDATE SET last_sequence = order_number_counters.last_sequence + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING last_sequence

SELECT order_number, customer_last_name, customer_first_name, customer_email, shipping_postal_code, shipping_prefecture, shipping_city, shipping_address_line, shipping_floor, shipping_has_elevator, payment_method, payment_instruction, subtotal_amount, assembly_fee_total, shipping_fee, tax_amount, total_amount FROM orders WHERE order_number = #{orderNumber}
SELECT order_number, order_datetime, total_amount, order_status FROM orders WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY order_datetime DESC, order_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT o.order_number, o.order_datetime, o.order_status, o.subtotal_amount, o.assembly_fee_total, o.shipping_fee, o.tax_amount, o.total_amount FROM orders o WHERE o.member_id = #{memberId} AND o.order_number = #{orderNumber}

SELECT osh.changed_at, osh.status FROM order_status_histories osh JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = osh.order_id WHERE o.member_id = #{memberId} AND o.order_number = #{orderNumber} ORDER BY osh.changed_at ASC, osh.order_status_history_id ASC

SELECT oi.product_code, oi.product_name, oi.color_name, oi.unit_price, oi.assembly_fee, oi.quantity, oi.line_subtotal FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.member_id = #{memberId} AND o.order_number = #{orderNumber} ORDER BY oi.order_item_id ASC

SELECT pv.product_variant_id, oi.product_code, oi.quantity, oi.assembly_available, oi.assembly_fee FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.product_code = oi.product_code WHERE o.member_id = #{memberId} AND o.order_number = #{orderNumber} ORDER BY oi.order_item_id ASC
SELECT tax_rate_percent FROM tax_rates WHERE is_active = TRUE AND effective_start_at <= #{now} AND (effective_end_at IS NULL OR effective_end_at > #{now}) ORDER BY effective_start_at DESC LIMIT 1
